regime_context: Absolute-trend gate is validated for drawdown control in HK. Six themes are currently eligible; momentum concentrates in Diversified Miners (ineligible, not trend-gated) and Tech Hardware (eligible but low breadth). No one-narrative dominant, rotation non-directional. Only one scorable theme passes the gate: China Tech & Internet. The macro backdrop is high-noise (unscheduled share 0.96).

theses.subject: China Tech & Internet
theses.thesis: The absolute-trend gate, the only validated edge, flags China Tech & Internet as eligible, pointing to a durable uptrend with historically lower drawdown risk. The theme carries a trend tag (hurst_tag=trend), a durability_bar of 0.7, and no crowding. Breadth (0.684) suggests moderate participation. This is a disciplined risk-control lean, not a return forecast.
theses.dissent: Trend can break abruptly, especially with very high macro unscheduled surprise share (0.96). The gate reduces drawdowns on average but not in every instance. Also, momentum rank is low (9th), offering no return signal.

falsifier.text: 3033.HK closes below its 20-day simple moving average for three consecutive sessions within the 20-day horizon.

theses.subject: China Platform Megacaps

Durability is below typical thresholds (0.59) despite a trend tag, confirming weak structure. Avoidance is a risk-discipline, not a directional call.
evidence: hurst_tag=trend but insufficient to pass gate
theses.dissent: The gate may be too restrictive in a mean-reverting regime; the theme might reverse higher, causing opportunity cost.

falsifier.text: 3033.HK (proxy) rallies above its 20-day high and holds above it for two consecutive sessions within the 20-day horizon.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
